name: THERMOSFEAR
author: hjonesjr
description:
LEGO Ideas username: HJonesJr 

THERMOSFEAR is an epic game that takes place in the Orbitron-C space station located in the Earth’s thermosphere. The game is based on an original suspense story in which you play as Astronaut “Brick” Jones who has been assigned to a recovery and extraction mission. Easy right? The catch is that something went terribly wrong inside the station one month ago and the crew had to be evacuated. Will you dare dock with the station, explore it and go out alive? Don’t let your FEAR dominate you…


WHY?
I think the most important aspect of a game is the story: it keeps the player motivated, it dictates the mood, defines the lighting and the music. I tried to combine all those aspects in this game plus the playability that any space and Lego fan would love. I had a blast building this game from scratch. I hope you have a blast playing it as well.
